case.title: Tech View density is kept after logout, in another browser and location
case.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You can switch to a second location, {Location-B}, and a second browser (or a second computer) is open on the sign-in page.
    For example: {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has one Approved work order, {Work-order-1}, with no lead technician.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Shared and {Work-order-1} is S1-702.
  • In Tech View the density is not "Comfortable".
    For example: it is "Regular".
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
case.custom_steps:
1. Look at the toolbar and at the space around the card of {Work-order-1}.
  2. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  3. Click the density button and choose "Comfortable".
  4. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  5. Log out.
  6. Sign in again as the same user.
  7. Open "Work Orders" and click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  8. Change location to {Location-B} (your initials at the top right > "Change Location").
  9. Open "Work Orders" and click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  10. In the second browser, sign in as the same user.
  11. In the second browser, open "Work Orders" and click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: Board View's toolbar has no density button.
  • Step 2: Tech View shows, with a density button in its toolbar.
  • Step 3: "Comfortable" is in use and the rows are roomier than before.
  • Step 4: Board View still has no density button, and the card of {Work-order-1} has the same spacing as at step 1. Choosing Comfortable in Tech View did not change Board View.
  • Step 5: you are signed out.
  • Step 6: you are signed in.
  • Step 7: Tech View opens with "Comfortable" still in use: the rows have the same roomy spacing as at step 3.
  • Step 8: the top bar shows {Location-B}.
  • Step 9: at {Location-B}, Tech View is at "Comfortable" too.
  • Step 10: you are signed in in the second browser.
  • Step 11: in the second browser, Tech View is at "Comfortable" too.

Known problem (SV-11580, Open; planned for this release): until it ships, Board View still shows the density button and its cards follow the density chosen in Tech View. (1) If you see exactly that, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results say, mark it Passed and tell the QA lead: the change has shipped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, stories SV-10049 (Story 6, Density in Tech View and Board View) and SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician); ticket SV-11580

  • S3-R11: “Board View shows no Density control in this release (SV-11580). Column Selection sits centered between the toolbar’s two dividers, with no empty gap where Density was. A Card size control as in the design (Compact and Detailed) follows as a fast follow (SV-11581).”
  • S6-R1: “Offer Compact, Regular, and Comfortable density in Tech View. Board View has no Density control in this release (S3-R11).”
  • S6-R3: “Density belongs to Tech View only. Board View’s fast-follow Card size (SV-11581) is saved separately.”
  • S6-E1: “Density applies to Tech View rows on Work Orders; Board View cards keep their current spacing in this release. List keeps today’s row size, and other application tables are unchanged.”
  • S6-R7: “Save density per user across sessions, logout/login, devices, and locations.”

Not yet checked against a build in this wording.

AUTOMATION: READY - EXPECT FAIL (SV-11580)

1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. A second browser or computer, and a second location you can switch to in the top bar.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • Leave Lead Technician empty.
    • On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
    • Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.

Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 2 browsers · a second location · about 15 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Shared" (used by this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] with no lead (it sits in Unassigned).
  • A second browser or computer, and a second location you can switch to (your initials at the top right > Change Location).
  • Density starts at something other than Comfortable (e.g. Regular), so the change in step 1 is a real change.
  • Names are examples.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  3. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Shared" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Shared": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Leave Lead Technician empty.
    • [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): no lead.
  5. Make sure you have a second browser or computer, and a second location you can switch to (your initials at the top right > Change Location shows it).
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Shared" shows [WO-1]; in Tech View the Density control is not on Comfortable (if it is, pick Regular). Then clear the search.

  • A second browser or computer, and a second location you can switch to (your initials at the top right > Change Location).
  • Density starts at something other than Comfortable (e.g. Regular), so the change in step 1 is a real change.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  3. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Shared" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Shared": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Leave Lead Technician empty.
    • [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): no lead.
  5. Make sure you have a second browser or computer, and a second location you can switch to (your initials at the top right > Change Location shows it).
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Shared" shows [WO-1]; in Tech View the Density control is not on Comfortable (if it is, pick Regular). Then clear the search.
